title: Dead or Alive 3 (Xbox, USA): the native runner's guest RAM
notes: Guest RAM of the pinned doa3-re v0.2 runner (gbox/doa3_native.py, gbox/doa3_memory.py): guest addresses are the XBE's own. Sources: capstone over the reviewed USA XBE (XBE_SHA256 e523dd15...), gbox/doa3_pad.py for the controller path; live checks on the i9-NUC through the verified channel.

groups.game: The main loop: its frame clock and top-level state
groups.pad: The controllers as the game converts them (0x0009EB90), and gBox's virtual pad on port 4
groups.p1: Player 1 (the bot): its block in the 0x68-stride player table at 0x484C48

1.evidence: 0 -> 1 when a mode starts from the menu (0x00083B51, [0x48A528] = the chosen mode)

2.evidence: the attract / title state the menus return to (0x00083AAC)

game.mode.description: Top-level state dispatched by the first game task (0x00084340, jump table 0x00084574: 0 -> 0x00083A90, 1 -> 0x00082950 / 0x00083BC0, 2 -> 0x00083920, 3 -> 0x000840C0, 4 -> 0x00084120)
game.mode.evidence: capstone over the USA XBE 2026-10-20: the task's loop reads it every pass; 19 writers (0x0004F987, 0x0008216B ... 0x000CF5C5)

1.evidence: 0x00079545 sets 1 while it resets the round's tasks

3.evidence: compared with 3 in 63 places (the fight's own checks)

4.evidence: 0x00078557 / 0x00078571 / 0x00078588 set 4 with the round's winner at 0x4705C2

game.phase.evidence: capstone 2026-10-20: written 0..5 by the round code (0x0006F1B6 .. 0x0007BA39), compared with 3 x63, 4 x29

game.round_winner.description: Who won the round, set with phase 4

game.chosen_mode.description: The game mode picked in the main menu (0x000CF7CB: a table 0x48A2A4 indexed by the menu cursor 0x48899F); copied to 0x48A528 when the mode starts
game.chosen_mode.evidence: 0x00083B2E: [0x48A528] = [0x47E723] as game.mode goes 0 -> 1; mode ids: the bytes 02 09 05 0A 0C 07 0B at 0x36926C beside the mode-name table 0x369274 (STORY, TAG MATCH, SURVIVAL, TEAM BATTLE, MAIN_WATCH, SPARRING, TAG SPARRING)

game.playing_mode.description: The mode being played (cleared on the way back to the title)
game.playing_mode.evidence: 0x00083B38 and the round code's checks (cmp 5 = Survival at 0x00078520 ...); ids as game.chosen_mode

game.menu_cursor.description: The main menu's cursor: the mode under it is game.menu_modes[cursor] (0x000CF7BE); to be confirmed live
game.menu_cursor.evidence: 0x000CF7BE: movzx ecx, [0x48899F]; mov dl, [ecx + 0x48A2A4]; mov [0x47E723], dl

game.menu_modes.description: The main menu's items as mode ids (built at run time: unlocks change it)

p1.active.description: Player block 0 in use (cleared when the menus start, 0x00083AC1)
p1.active.evidence: 0x00083AC1 / 0x00083AC7 clear both; the join code tests them

game.qpc.description: QueryPerformanceCounter at the start of each main-loop pass (0x000A0370, the loop's first call)
game.qpc.evidence: 0x000A0370 stores the counter from 0x00163D6E at 0x85B988 every pass

game.frame_ring.description: Frame-time ring index 0..7, advanced once a frame after the game tasks ran (0x000A0440, called after the scheduler 0x0009E67B): a new value = the frame's logic is done

game.tick.description: KeTickCount read once a main-loop pass (0x00164400 -> 0x000A0706), before the game tasks
game.tick.evidence: 0x000A0701 call 0x00164400 (mov eax, [0x1ED180]; mov eax, [eax]) -> mov [0x85B9C8], eax

pad.connected.description: Ports the poll (0x0009EAF0) read this frame: a non-zero handle slot
pad.connected.evidence: 0x0009EB7C stores the mask built from the handle slots 0x5E5D48 + port * 0x80

pad.held.description: Buttons held on any port this frame (the menus read these all-port masks)
pad.held.evidence: 0x0009EB90 ORs every port's converted mask into 0x5E5F88 (held), 0x5E5F8C (previous), 0x5E5F90 (newly pressed)

pad.pressed.description: Buttons newly pressed on any port this frame

pad.port4_handle.description: Port 4's XInput handle slot: gBox's virtual pad claims it (gbox/doa3_pad.py)

pad.port4_buttons.description: Port 4's XINPUT_GAMEPAD wButtons (gBox's virtual pad writes it)

players.port.description: The controller port each player reads (the title gives P1 the port that pressed START; START on a free port mid-fight joins as a challenger, 0x000822BB)
players.port.evidence: 0x000126A7 (the per-player input loop) and the title's join code 0x000823B9

p1.input.description: P1's input this frame in game bits (0x00011000 maps the D-pad and the port's button table 0x219798: X = F, Y = P, B = K, A = F+P)
p1.input.evidence: 0x0001274A stores pad | the stick block 0x3C2818 for each player

p2.input.description: P2's input this frame in game bits (a CPU's comes from its AI)

p2.attack_input.description: P2's Punch / Kick newly pressed this frame (the per-player pressed word, 0x48A494 + player * 2): the attack-input edge DOA2's holds key on
p2.attack_input.evidence: 0x0001276F stores (cur & ~prev) | the stick block's pressed bits for each player; to be confirmed live for a CPU

p1.move.description: P1's current move (an index into its move table; +0x2E of its 0x68-byte player block)
p1.move.evidence: 0x000A6A20 (set move): [block + 0x2E] = move, [block + 0x33] = the move table's byte 3; 0x000B0210 sets a pair (move, move + 1) for both players (throws, holds)

p1.move_class.description: The current move's class: byte 3 of its 8-byte move table entry (0x0009E9A0 kind 0)
p1.move_class.evidence: 0x000A6A6B / 0x000A5FD2: table[move * 8 + 3]; compared with 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 0xA, 0xB, 0xD, 0xE in the input and round code

p1.slot.description: P1's fighter slot (0..3): which of the 7-table sets at 0x4889BC + slot * 0x1C it uses

p1.chara.description: Character index of player block 0 (+0x66): selects the character tables at 0x488A28 + n * 4 (0x0009E9B1); to be confirmed live
p1.chara.evidence: 0x0009E9B1: movzx ecx, [player * 0x68 + 0x484CAE]; names (candidate order): the select screen's name table 0x368258 (sel_data.cpp)

p2.chara.description: Character index of player block 1 (+0x66); to be confirmed live
